tickets.title: As a Student, I want to verify my .edu email, so that only campus users join.
tickets.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if signup requires email verification before account activation.
- PASS if non-approved domains are rejected with a clear message.
- FAIL if an unverified user can create listings or chats.

tickets.title: As a Student, I want to scan textbook barcodes, so that listings are faster.
tickets.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if camera barcode scan can populate ISBN when permission is granted.
- PASS if users can manually edit title and ISBN before posting.
- FAIL if a failed scan prevents manual entry.

tickets.title: As a Student, I want to choose fixed price or auction, so that I can sell flexibly.
tickets.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if listing creation supports fixed-price and auction sale type.
- PASS if auction listings require end time and starting price.
- FAIL if payment is processed inside the app.

analysis.ambiguity1: Requirement: Only people with a valid .edu email address can create an account. This is vague because it does not define whether any .edu domain is accepted, whether only the university domain counts, how email ownership is verified, or whether alumni and staff are allowed.
analysis.ambiguity2: Requirement: Students want auctions, not just fixed prices. This is vague because it does not define bidding duration, minimum increments, reserve prices, winner selection, cancellation rules, or how auctions work when the app cannot process payments.
analysis.conflictSolution: Conflict: The University Legal Team says the app cannot process payments, while the Student Union wants a 2% transaction fee. Resolution: for the MVP, the marketplace must not collect payments or transaction fees. Listings may show payment instructions for cash or third-party apps, but settlement happens outside the app. Student Union funding should use a separate approved donation or sponsorship flow that is not required to complete a marketplace transaction.
analysis.nfr1: Access control and security: Account creation must verify campus eligibility through approved .edu email rules and protect user contact information.
analysis.nfr2: Safety: Physical meetup workflows must require an approved Safe Exchange Zone before users can start listing-specific chat.
analysis.nfr3: Legal and compliance: The platform must not process, hold, or calculate required transaction payments or fees for peer-to-peer sales.
